note: atlas-houseboat-ip-1127 (written 2026-11-27, not run): Boundless Atlas docs/057 §6.3 Island Paradise houseboat jobs on Atlas main 0.3.20 (asi 7c972767, script half atlas-main20b-1127 pkg=8cda3053, houseboat native 2, script 0.1.0-hb1, FarDock 0.1.0-hb4), two arms [Houseboat] FarDock=0 / 1 with StripCheck=1 and Verbose=1. Steam 1.67, Apex + RTX Remix bridge (Bin state apex). Run FarDock=0 first (it writes no sidecar). Household rule: household Sims (Dregg) get no agent action: they only play under EA (autopilot ultra, dialogs accepted); the slide check is a dry run (nothing written, oneWay = 1). Covered: read-backs (native, script with the HB-2 strip line, fardock start), scenario 1 slide-check half (whole-world dry step: household-in-dropped-column, never pos-unknown, both arms), scenario 3 save bracket + sidecar read-back at an in-game reload (FarDock=1), scenario 5 world-quit counters (both arms). Not covered, with why: scenario 1 sailing half (Isla Paradiso has no window seam and a real rebase slide is not a job on an EA world; HB-3 FollowHull is not built; the helm CruiseHere / MoveToPort labels and port picker rows are unverified for do_interaction, and the household result there must stay vanilla); scenario 2 (no agent command picks an NPC-household houseboat by scope: houseboat_move's HbPick prefers any lived-in boat and can take the active Dregg Atlantis, and none pushes MoveToPort on an NPC driver; [Houseboat] Verbose is unused in version 1, so the computed point is not logged for a camera move: natural NPC sails during the 6 min window show only in the counters); scenario 3 mid-trip parts (needs a parked trip first, from scenario 2) and the older-save stale check; scenario 4 (needs a real, non-dry slide on Isla Paradiso with an unseen docked NPC hull in the dropped column; the dry whole-world step stops at the household refusal first). These need a new agent command (NPC houseboat pick by scope + MoveToPort on its driver + camera to a hull) first. The 300 ms routing fail-fast (routingFailFast) needs run.profile; these are run.repro jobs (they reload and quit the world), so it is not armed: read routing from the row. node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/atlas-houseboat-ip-1127.json Rebase window (2026-11-27): Atlas Rebase.cs SlideRefusal reads RebaseNative.Window, which is the routing world box [WM+0xB4, + 32 x width) x [WM+0xB8, + 32 x height) (native/atlas/rebase.cpp IcWindow, Atlas main 7ed0c75): it is set whenever a world is loaded, so Isla Paradiso always has one; an empty box (no routing world) is forbidden by name, and the slidecheck 8192 0 step drops every point of a window up to 8192 m wide, so the household (on land or on its hull, HB-0) is always in the dropped column.
